name: Four Seasons Hotel Marrakech
positioning: Garden resort in Marrakech's Hivernage district with Moorish palace-style buildings, set on 40 acres (16 hectares)
best_for: Travelers who want a garden retreat with pools and a Moroccan spa
Families who want a supervised kids program and villas with kitchenettes

facts.text: Four Seasons Resort Marrakech opened in June 2011.
The resort's address is 1 Boulevard de la Menara, Marrakech.
The resort sits on 40 acres (16 hectares) of grounds.
The resort is set within Hivernage, Marrakech's cosmopolitan district.
The resort has 141 rooms and suites.
The main buildings evoke a Moorish palace.
Quattro restaurant serves a contemporary interpretation of Mediterranean flavours each evening.
Inara Restaurant & Lounge serves a contemporary interpretation of Morocco's culinary heritage.
Azzera restaurant and bar has a view of the adult pool.
The resort has two floodlit clay tennis courts.

highlights.text: Zest Rooftop Lounge has views of the Atlas Mountains and city gardens.
Patio Suites with Private Pool open to a private terrace with a heated plunge pool.
The adults-only quiet pool has private cabanas.
The Kids For All Seasons program is complimentary.
The Two-Bedroom Villa with Private Pool has a kitchenette.

considerations.text: Four Seasons describes the resort as a 10-minute drive from the city's most compelling sights.
The airport meet and greet service requires 48-hours notice.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing reflects the luxury positioning.

perks.text: With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, breakfast for two is free daily.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a priority upgrade if available at check-in.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a $100 hotel credit.
WhataHotel special offers can be combined with the exclusive perks.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get free Wi-Fi access.
